name: Stonecrest Next Gen Youth Leadership Program
what_you_do: Meet one Saturday a month. You meet city leaders and learn how city government works. You also learn about public safety and leadership. You learn about community and economic development. One trip is to the Georgia State Capitol.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 for 2026-27 who attend a high school inside the City of Stonecrest. A parent or guardian must register you and send one proof of school enrollment. You must commit to regular attendance.
duration: 6 Saturday sessions, 10 am to 1 pm, Oct 2026 to Mar 2027
deadline_text: The city's Sept. 3, 2026 notice says registration opens that day. No deadline is listed. It closes when all 30 spots are filled. Sessions: Oct 24, Nov 14, Dec 12, 2026; Jan 30, Feb (Capitol date to be set), Mar 20, 2027.
how_to_apply: A parent or guardian fills out the Stonecrest NextGen Program Application Form on the program page and sends proof of enrollment. Spots are first-come, first-served.
notes: Only 30 spots. City Hall: 3120 Stonecrest Boulevard, Suite 190, Stonecrest, GA 30038, 770-224-0200. Write to Nicholas Ivey at nivey@stonecrestga.gov. Unpaid, so no work permit.
